content.text:
ANSWER: All four functions live in **`src/http/mod.rs`**:

| Function | Role |
|---|---|
| `origin_allowed(origin, shared)` (line 334) | Top-level decision gate. Returns `true` if the request's `Origin` header matches any of three conditions: an explicit allowlist entry (including `*`), the server's own base URL, or a loopback/local-machine origin. |
| `is_loopback_host(host)` (line 96) | Local-machine check. Returns `true` for `"localhost"` or any IP address whose `IpAddr::is_loopback()` returns true (i.e. `127.x.x.x`, `::1`). |
| `host_of(url)` (line 102) | Helper — strips the scheme and port from a URL, returning just the bare hostname so `is_loopback_host` can be called on it. Used by `origin_allowed` to extract the host from the incoming origin string. |
| `origin_of(url)` (line 112) | Helper — extracts the `scheme://host[:port]` tuple from a URL. Used by `origin_allowed` to compare the request origin against the server's configured `base_url`. |

The logic in `origin_allowed` (line 338) is:
```
|| host_of(&o).is_some_and(|h| is_loopback_host(&h))
```
meaning any origin whose host is `localhost` or a loopback IP is unconditionally allowed, regardless of the `allow_origins` configuration.

CONFIDENCE: high
